ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels covering approximately 97% of the visible fluke surface; high-intensity pixels are limited to localized epibiotic growth and small surface artifacts.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark low-intensity field across both lobes; no contiguous geometric white blobs or macro-level mottling patterns detected.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a clearly defined central vertex; depth of depression is roughly 1/8th of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations characterized by jagged peaks and valleys along the entire continuous trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile on the distal edges of both lobes leading to rounded, barnacle-encrusted tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of high-contrast, roughly circular beige/white pixel groups located at the distal tips and scattered sparsely on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of sessile barnacles (Coronula diadema) concentrated on the trailing edges and terminal tips of both fluke lobes.
